summary: TRACK 28.05 Session 2 Phase 15 device walk complete. Frontend Fleet/Dispatch/Shop/Driver surfaces render correctly across Desktop (1920x800), Tablet (768x1024) and Mobile (390x844). Motive+MaintainX integration health card verified. Permission gates redirect unauth users. Zero TEST_28_05_* leakage. Zero raw UTC/GMT/ISO timestamps in operator-facing labels. defects_found.issue: Horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth) at mobile viewport. Other Fleet/Dispatch/Shop pages render cleanly on same viewport.

Uncaught runtime error: TypeError: (title || "untitled").toLowerCase is not a function. Page renders full-page error banner instead of the work order detail. Only observed during PDF-export exploration; not on canonical Track 28.05 Fleet/Dispatch/Shop routes but surfaced via Shop portal navigation.
defects_found.note: Report to main agent for Shop PM triage; does not block Track 28.05 device walk.

per_viewport_notes.desktop_1920x800: Canonical PortalShell (top nav bar with Transportation Operations / Operations / People / Compliance / Ops Intelligence / Administration) + Admin OS SideNav render on all tested Fleet/Dispatch/Shop routes. Breadcrumbs (ADMIN OS > FIELD OPERATIONS > EQUIPMENT PRE-OP) visible on Daily Walk-Arounds page. KPI cards on Dispatch Board (Active Hauls 271 / Waiting 0 / Breakdown 0 / Stuck>30m 271). Integration Center shows 4 cards (Motive/Maintainx overview + Records Mapped / Last Sync / Last Success / Last Failure fields). No layout issues.
per_viewport_notes.tablet_768x1024: All 8 tested routes (/dispatch-portal/board, /shop, /shop/manager/queue, /dispatch-portal/fleet, /equipment/new, /shift, /admin/equipment, /admin/integrations) render with NO horizontal overflow. Filter rows + KPI cards wrap cleanly.
per_viewport_notes.mobile_390x844: 8 of 9 tested routes render without horizontal overflow. Submit buttons reachable on Pre-Op and DVIR forms (screenshot confirms 'SUBMIT' pinned in header on /equipment/new mobile). ONLY /shop/manager/queue overflows horizontally on mobile — see defect 28-05-DW-001.

pdf_export_check.note: Page exposes EMAIL + PRINT actions. No explicit 'Download PDF' control that triggers an application/pdf download. If Track 28.05 acceptance strictly requires a direct application/pdf blob download (as worded in spec), this is a gap. PRINT likely relies on browser window.print() (user Save-as-PDF flow) rather than a server-generated PDF endpoint. Flag for main agent confirmation — backend cert covered the server side; the UI affordance labelled 'Download PDF' was not located on Pre-Op detail.

console_errors_summary: 0 console errors across the full 17-route walk (desktop + tablet + mobile). Only expected 401 network probes observed on /dispatch-portal hub (documented in spec as acceptable).
unrelated_observation_out_of_scope: Rows prefixed TEST_CAT320_INSP_* (not TEST_28_05_*) are visible on /admin/equipment-inspections and its detail pages. These are NOT part of Track 28.05 acceptance (which strictly gates TEST_28_05_*) so the device walk passes on the stated criterion, but the general synthetic_fleet_filter appears to not scrub other TEST_ prefixes from the Daily Walk-Arounds surface. Recommend widening the filter scope in a future track.

Track separately (not blocking Track 28.05): fix runtime error `(title || "untitled").toLowerCase is not a function` on /shop/pm/work-orders/:id — Card component at bundle.js:182331 (defect 28-05-DW-002).

Clarify PDF export UX: Pre-Op detail exposes EMAIL + PRINT, not an explicit 'Download PDF' button. Confirm whether PRINT satisfies Track 28.05 acceptance or a dedicated PDF download control is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Route drift between certification spec and implemented routes — spec lists /fleet, /admin/equipment-master, /driver/shift/start, /admin/motive which all 404. Either add redirect aliases or update the cert doc to canonical routes.

synthetic_fleet_filter only scrubs TEST_28_05_* prefixes; other TEST_* prefixes (e.g., TEST_CAT320_*) still surface in operator-facing lists like /admin/equipment-inspections. Broaden filter for defensive UX.
PDF export UX inconsistency: some detail pages have PRINT+EMAIL, others may have Download PDF — normalize the download affordance.
